_comment: Prediction module. rehearsal = the 80 papers picked from Stage 1 for the 100-paper rehearsal (user decision 2026-10-16); the 20 benchmark papers, incl. 2 known positives, are excluded. With 0 flagged the page shows only the 95% Wilson upper bound. Never enter a number that is not from a run record. The running count is read from the public API, counting every paper on the public list. poll: the visitor prediction poll served by the D backend vote service (GET/POST {apiBase}{path}); keep enabled false until that service is approved and deployed. Choice ids must match the backend's polls.json.
